programming_spec: Microchip DS70102K / dsPIC30F Flash Programming Specification
address_model: 24-bit instruction words, PC increments by 2, host HEX stores one instruction as 4 bytes
safety_notes: Configuration and user-ID areas are excluded by default by host program-hex.
Bulk erase needs validated target power and VPP; verify the front-end measurement before attaching a real part.
Debug Executive assets must come from the user's local Microchip DFP/MPLAB installation.
